headline: The bomb defuses itself — one more classic learns to play itself
lede: WATCH batch 15 seats TALK ME DOWN: press Y and the puzzle's own rulebook solver takes the defuser's hands — the same planner its harness wins 200 seeds out of 200 with, cutting live at real speed.

notes.text: TALK ME DOWN: the solver that reads every stamped rule and cuts only the correct wire now defuses for you — module by module, dial by dial, glyph by glyph. Reactive every tick, so a mid-bomb Y is honest from whatever mess you're in; any key or tap takes the cutters back. V stays the mic: heard words are orders, not hands.
One tap on the green WATCH button now starts the run AND seats the solver — the seat banks itself across the squad-size screen, so the forgotten-how-to-play tap works even on a two-screen boot.

Harness: 1 pilot + 9 source pins in watchcheck (198 checks on the new title, 601/601 full suite), phone tripwire 53->54, a mutant (seat feed cut) killed exactly 4 gates and was restored. Honest catch: a lone git checkout mid-session wiped uncommitted fixes — CI static caught it, and the fix now goes in commit-first. Coverage 54 -> 55.
Batch 15's honesty gate ran as designed: the seat shipped because the title's own smoke already proves solvePad wins every seed. No proven route, no button.
